item.title: Enhancing Population Health Assessment: Key Papers from the EQ-DAPHNIE Project
item.content:encoded:
Brittany Lapin, Cleveland Clinic

Jessica Roydhouse, University of Tasmania

The EQ-DAPHNIE project, funded by the EuroQol Research Foundation, conducted an extensive population health assessment across 15 countries, collecting demographic data, social determinants of health, and multiple generic and disease-specific patient-reported outcome measures. This special collection brings together research emerging from this landmark initiative that addresses various aspects of health measurement and population variation.

Appel publié par Quality of Life Research. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Population health assessment
  • Patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs)
  • Population norms
  • Cross-country comparisons
  • Health inequalities
  • Instrument performance
  • Self-reported health
  • Elderly population health measures
